tool_calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"set -euo pipefail
check_dir=$(mktemp -d)
for f in mod-tome.lua tome-ashes-urhrok.lua tome-cults.lua; do
  env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua "$f" "$check_dir/current-$f.jsonl"
  env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua ".ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/baseline/$f" "$check_dir/baseline-$f.jsonl"
done
python3 - "$check_dir" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
files=['mod-tome.lua','tome-ashes-urhrok.lua','tome-cults.lua']
target=[]; args=[]; other=[]
current_by_source={}
for f in files:
    def records(kind):
        return [json.loads(x) for x in (root/f'{kind}-{f}.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x]
    cur=[x for x in records('current') if x['kind']=='translation']
    base=[x for x in records('baseline') if x['kind']=='translation']
    assert len(cur)==len(base), (f,len(cur),len(base))
    for i,(b,c) in enumerate(zip(base,cur),1):
        for k in ('function_name','section','source','source_tag','special'):
            if b.get(k)!=c.get(k): other.append((f,i,k,b.get(k),c.get(k)))
        if b.get('target')!=c.get('target'): target.append((f,c['section'],c['source'],b['target'],c['target']))
        if b.get('args_order')!=c.get('args_order'): args.append((f,c['section'],c['source'],b.get('args_order'),c.get('args_order')))
        current_by_source.setdefault((f,c['source']),[]).append(c)
assert len(target)==22, len(target)
assert len(args)==4, len(args)
assert not other, other
work=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/WORKSET.json'))
assert {(x['normalized_path'],x['source']) for x in work['items']} == {(f,s) for f,_,s,_,_ in target}
env=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f1a2.json'))['payload']['translation_snapshot']
round_changes=[]
for x in env:
    wi=next(w for w in work['items'] if w['entry_revision_identity']==x['revision_key'])
    matches=current_by_source[(wi['normalized_path'],x['source'])]
    assert len(matches)==1, (wi['normalized_path'],x['revision_key'],len(matches))
    if matches[0]['target']!=x['target']:
        round_changes.append((x['revision_key'],x['target'],matches[0]['target']))
assert [x[0] for x in round_changes]==['56b7b501ebbaac94c74fd082e2b8d865727dbcf12fd7f2a4c3805021cd877d70'], round_changes
print('LuaJIT load: PASS (current + baseline; 3 files each)')
print('baseline target changes:',len(target))
print('baseline args_order changes:',len(args))
print('other semantic field changes:',len(other))
print('cycle-2 target changes vs F1 candidate:',len(round_changes),round_changes[0][0][:10])
print('changed target before:',json.dumps(round_changes[0][1],ensure_ascii=False))
print('changed target after: ',json.dumps(round_changes[0][2],ensure_ascii=False))
PY
rm -r "$check_dir"","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output);
